'''Mindemir''' was the primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Mindemir system/Legends|Mindemir system]]. [[Jenna Zan Arbor]] wanted to use the planet's [[Water/Legends|water]] supplies in her experiments, but was blocked from doing so by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
